9: require "elastic_graph/errors"
10: require "elastic_graph/schema_artifacts/runtime_metadata/extension"
11: require "elastic_graph/schema_artifacts/runtime_metadata/interface_verifier"
12: 
13: module ElasticGraph
14:   module SchemaArtifacts
15:     module RuntimeMetadata
16:       # Responsible for loading extensions. This loader requires an interface definition
17:       # (a class or module with empty method definitions that just serves to define what
18:       # loaded extensions must implement). That allows us to verify the extension implements
19:       # the interface correctly at load time, rather than deferring exceptions to when the
20:       # extension is later used.
21:       #
22:       # Note, however, that this does not guarantee no runtime exceptions from the use of the
23:       # extension: the extension may return invalid return values, or throw exceptions when
24:       # called. But this verifies the interface to the extent that we can.
25:       #
26:       # @private
27:       class ExtensionLoader
28:         def initialize(interface_def)
29:           @interface_def = interface_def
30:           @loaded_by_name = {}
31:         end
32: 
33:         # Loads the extension using the provided constant name, after requiring the `from` path.
34:         # Memoizes the result.
35:         def load(constant_name, from:, config:)
36:           (@loaded_by_name[constant_name] ||= load_extension(constant_name, from)).tap do |extension|
37:             if extension.require_path != from
38:               raise Errors::InvalidExtensionError, "Extension `#{constant_name}` cannot be loaded from `#{from}`, " \
39:                 "since it has already been loaded from `#{extension.require_path}`."
40:             end
41:           end.with(config: config)
42:         end
43: 
44:         private
45: 
46:         def load_extension(constant_name, require_path)
47:           require require_path
48:           extension_class = ::Object.const_get(constant_name)
49:           Extension.new(extension_class, require_path, {}, constant_name.delete_prefix("::")).tap do |ext|
50:             ext.verify_against!(@interface_def)
51:           end
52:         end
53:       end
54:     end
55:   end
56: end

145:           config.fetch("name"),
146:           from: config.fetch("require_path"),
147:           config: config.except("name", "require_path")
148:         )
149:         extension_class = extension.extension_class # : ::Class
150: 
151:         __skip__ = extension_class.new(extension.config)
152:       end
153: 
154:       def load_extension_modules(extension_module_hashes)
155:         extension_loader = SchemaArtifacts::RuntimeMetadata::ExtensionLoader.new(::Module.new)
156: 
157:         extension_module_hashes.map do |mod_hash|
158:           extension_loader.load(mod_hash.fetch("name"), from: mod_hash.fetch("require_path"), config: {}).extension_class.tap do |mod|
159:             unless mod.instance_of?(::Module)
160:               raise Errors::ConfigError, "`#{mod_hash.fetch("name")}` is not a module, but all application extension modules must be modules."
161:             end
162:           end
163:         end
164:       end
165:     end
166:   end
167: end

def load_extension_modules(extension_module_hashes)
        extension_loader = SchemaArtifacts::RuntimeMetadata::ExtensionLoader.new(::Module.new)

        extension_module_hashes.map do |mod_hash|
          extension_loader.load(mod_hash.fetch("name"), from: mod_hash.fetch("require_path"), config: {}).extension_class.tap do |mod|
            unless mod.instance_of?(::Module)
              raise Errors::ConfigError, "`#{mod_hash.fetch("name")}` is not a module, but all application extension modules must be modules."
            end
          end
        end
      end
